name: lean
title: Lean 4 with Mathlib
summary: Checks Lean 4 proofs against Mathlib: one file, or a folder of files that import each other, with an optional independent replay through Lean's kernel. A batch checker; for interactive proving, see README.

tools.name: lean-check
tools.does: checks one Lean file against Mathlib (import Mathlib works). Exit code 0 with no errors means the file compiles; a file using 'sorry' compiles with a warning
tools.check:
printf 'import Mathlib
theorem t (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a := by omega
#print axioms t
' > t.lean; lean-check t.lean && echo compiled

tools.name: lean-tree
tools.does: checks a folder of Lean files that import each other (DIR/A/B.lean is module A.B). Compiled files are kept in DIR/.olean and reused. -v shows what Lean prints; -c re-checks every compiled module with leanchecker, an independent replay through the kernel
tools.usage: lean-tree DIR   |   lean-tree -v DIR   |   lean-tree -c DIR
tools.check:
mkdir -p p/A; printf 'theorem one : 1 + 1 = 2 := rfl
' > p/A/B.lean; printf 'import A.B
theorem two : 2 = 1 + 1 := one.symm
' > p/C.lean; lean-tree p
